notablePrerequisites: Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger has indestructible.
description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
